snippet.title: 3D Docking Mission - (1978) - Apple II - WIN! HD
snippet.description:
3D Docking Mission
[Computer] Apple II
By: Programma International © 1978 
Emulator:  AppleWin 1.2

Nice little variation on the Lunar Lander type of game... you have to fly from Left to Right of the screen to dock straight-on with a spaceport.  The trick is you have to match both horizontal (left-right) and veritcal (up-down) by looking at two screens of action.  Score:  228
